name: Backgrounds
description: Quiet backgrounds behind the app, in its own colours: aurora, constellation, a dot grid, and a still dusk gradient. Pick one in Settings, Appearance.
author: OpenAgent

settings.title: Intensity
settings.description: How much colour the background carries. Text stays readable at every level.

settings.title: Speed
settings.description: How fast the moving backgrounds drift. With reduced motion turned on in the system they hold still.
